Review Title: System back button exits the app completely!
Review Text: On Android, pressing the system back gesture while reading comments should take me back to the feed. Instead, Circle closes the app immediately! I have to re-launch every single time.

Review Title: Notification flood with no channel grouping
Review Text: Woke up to 34 notifications on my lockscreen. The Android notification channels are not categorized into spaces or direct messages. Either all alerts on or all off.

Review Title: Heavy WebView wrapper lag and battery drain
Review Text: You can tell this is an embedded WebView. Scroll performance drops to 30fps on long discussions, and the battery drain on my phone is double that of native Flutter or React Native apps.
Embedded Vimeo/Wistia videos freeze while audio continues for a few seconds before cutting off. Impossible to complete course modules on mobile.

Review Title: Paywall error: Cannot renew membership from Android
Review Text: Received an error message saying paywall configuration missing when trying to renew my annual cohort pass. Customer support told me to open Chrome on PC.

Review Title: No sensory consideration: Bright jarring white UI
Review Text: Even in dark mode the white flash between space navigation blinds me at night. Sudden loud sound effects on notifications trigger sensory overload. Please add calm themes.

Review Title: Draft vanished after phone call interrupted typing
Review Text: I spent 20 minutes drafting an introduction post. An incoming phone call switched apps, and when I returned the text box was completely blank. No draft autosave!

Review Title: Tablet layout is just a stretched phone screen
Review Text: On my 11-inch tablet the feed is stretched edge to edge with huge empty margins and awkward line lengths. Needs an adaptive two-column or navigation rail layout.

Review Title: No offline reading cache for subways
Review Text: As soon as the subway enters a tunnel, discussions show an error cloud and will not let me read cached reflections or lesson notes. Needs an offline-first database.
Audio events and podcast recordings stop when the phone screen turns off. No media session notification in Android quick settings to play/pause.
